notes: Fewer closed jobs. Before a job is added, Claude now checks the company's hiring system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters or Workday) to confirm the job is still open, and skips any job it cannot read in full on the employer's own page. Jobs already in your tracker get the same check twice a week.
